verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's core function, model inference across chat, embeddings, image, speech and vision, is documented as API-first through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Its API parameters include service_tier, fail_fast and reasoning_effort. Nothing shows that UI functions such as private-model deployment, dedicated instances, GPU cluster rental, API key management or billing can be done through the API, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of deployment/instance management, account/key/billing management via API, a published OpenAPI spec or explicit UI-parity statement, and independent corroboration.
